task:
COLONY PLANNER S3b: SURFACE SLOT PREDICTIONS. Start from current main. Step P (the governed purge) reached `complete` on 2026-10-31 (docs/ROADMAP.md, docs/operations/infrastructure-status.md), which was S3b's only gate. Read and implement exactly the S3b parts of docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-30-v3-colony-planner-design.md (section 5.3 "S3b (after step P completes)", the slice table row in section 7, the "Slot counts" risk in section 8, and the page behaviour in section 3: surface slots are predicted unless the commander has entered a value; the source shows "predicted" or "entered by you"; orbital slots are never predicted). Use the existing canonical predictor apps/api/src/ingest/slot_prediction.py (`validated-slot-v1`) and its algorithm doc docs/colonisation-redesign/validated-slot-prediction-algorithm.md; do not write a second formula.

DATA. Extend the bodies route `/api/v1/plan/systems/{id64}/bodies` (S3a, apps/api/src/routers/plan.py and its helpers) with, per body, the predicted surface slot count, the prediction version and status, and which inputs were missing. Inputs come from the table in the design (radius ×1000, temperature, gravity, atmosphere/terraforming/volcanism display names, signal counts) and `planet_class` from `v3_derived.body_mechanics.body_class` of the published derived generation. Apply the same generation guard S5b uses in apps/api/src/routers/plan_economy_facts.py: read body_mechanics only when the published derived generation's canonical generation matches the canonical generation the bodies route reads; otherwise every prediction field is null with a reason, and the route never returns 503 for this. Predictions only for landable bodies; non-landable, barycentres and belts have no surface prediction. Bounded, parameterized SQL only; no migration; the evaluate route stays database-free (a test already enforces that only the bodies route has a database dependency).

WEB. Wire the prediction into the /plan page's surface slot display with its source label ("predicted" vs "entered by you"); an entered value always wins and stays editable; an unknown prediction stays unknown. Regenerate both generated API clients the repo's way and run the generator twice to confirm the second run changes nothing (exact commands: see how #967/S5b did it in its CHANGES entry or the openapi-types CI job).

TESTS. Unit tests for the mapping from route rows to predictor inputs (unit conversions, null handling, generation-guard mismatch). Extend tests/test_plan_bodies_postgres.py (PostgreSQL 18; the reviewer runs it locally and CI's Finder shards run it) with: predictions for landable bodies, none for non-landable/belts/barycentres, the mismatch guard, and the design's answer-key system if a fixture for it exists in the repo (search tests/ and docs/ for the 2026-10-31 24-landable-body check; if no committed fixture exists, say so and do not invent data). Web component tests for the source labels and that an entered value wins. Update the planner Cypress spec only if a selector depends on the old display.

DOCS: dated CHANGES.md entry; mark S3b done in the planner design status if it keeps one.

VALIDATION, report each: apps/web `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm check`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`; generator twice with no second-run diff; the whole database-free Python suite `python -m pytest -q tests/ --ignore=tests/integration --ignore=tests/test_v3_spatial_pyramid.py --ignore=tests/test_admin_cache_truthfulness.py --ignore=tests/test_journal_commander_association.py` with no failures; `ruff check apps/api tests`. List the PostgreSQL tests the reviewer must run.
